services.desc: Adam Inzalaco is a Massachusetts-based artist who studied fine art at Stony Brook University. Here, he would develop a focus in sculpture within the Fine Art Program at SBU. Throughout his time here, Inzalaco would develop a strong understanding of a wide array of materials and media including steel, bronze, woodworking, ceramics, and many more. Throughout his academic career, he would often focus his assignments to revolve around the topic of entomology. He would design works to bring attention to various species of insects’ impressive anatomy as well as address the importance that insects play in the planet’s ecosystem.
